name: Sibopirdine
summary: Sibopirdine, also known as EXP921, is a nootropic drug.

uses.en: It was studied as an experimental nootropic, a drug meant to improve memory and thinking. It was never marketed.
uses.zh: 它曾被當作實驗性的益智藥研究，也就是用來改善記憶與思考的藥物，但從未上市。
uses.zhHans: 它曾被当作实验性的益智药研究，也就是用来改善记忆与思考的药物，但从未上市。

fact.en: Its name shares the ending of linopirdine, another experimental drug studied for memory, and during development it carried the code name EXP921.
fact.zh: 它的名稱字尾與另一種曾被研究用於記憶的實驗藥物linopirdine相同，研發期間的代號是EXP921。
fact.zhHans: 它的名称后缀与另一种曾被研究用于记忆的实验药物linopirdine相同，研发期间的代号是EXP921。
